text: COMPLETE at merge 7cf9d58. Chief gate on the merged tree, unpiped, SBT_EXIT=0, zero errors: scalafmt both, compileAll all platforms, align 172/172 x3, embedBench 52/52, lawsJVM 81/81, interviewJVM 76/76. All four required pieces landed: mass-weighted fidelity over the anchor distribution with per-facet N_f/A_f (fidelityMass, fidelityByFacet), compression and coherence as ratio-of-sums (MassRatio), and a DERIVED estimandVersion. CHIEF CHECK BEFORE ACK, recorded because it nearly became a wrong block: fidelity: Option[Double] is RETAINED alongside fidelityMass: MassRatio, which looked like the deprecated-twin pattern forbidden for route:transition-direction. It is not - signature.scala:316 shows 'val fidelity = fidelityRatio.value', so the old field is a projection of the new ratio, not the old cliff computation; and the remaining 'sourceMass > externalMass' at line 272 governs which units receive a per-unit FidelityReport, a different question from the aggregate. RESIDUAL, NOT A BLOCK, folded into the migration backlog rather than filed separately: fidelity as a bare Option[Double] beside the supported fidelityMass is an ADR 0003 clause-2 convenience leak - the library offers a way to quote the number without its support, which is exactly what externalMass deliberately prevents by having no sum accessor. It goes when the remaining Option[Double] fields migrate. NOT blocking a strict improvement for incompleteness, which is the error made earlier tonight on this same author's projection fix.
